# Not yet verified

The spec lists these as open; they are reported, never hidden:

- Text libraries (.msp, pDeep, ms2pip) could be read through the same table: mzLib's MslConverter.FromMspFile parses one into an in-memory MslLibrary. Left out of v1 because the conversion fills not-available defaults for every field LibrarySpectrum lacks, and because SpectralLibrary picks the text dialect from the file name. Revisit on demand.
- fragment\_count is carried only with fragments: without them mzLib's index-only entries have an empty fragment list (MslLibrary.GetEntry(i, false), 'do not rely on MatchedFragmentIons being empty or full'), and the stored MslPrecursorRecord.FragmentCount is not public. A public count would give the precursor table this column at no I/O cost (PUSH-TO-MAINLAND).
- No decoy filter is offered: MslLibrary.GetAllEntries(includeDecoys: false) has one, but GetAllEntries yields m/z order with no index, so the bridge reads by index and the caller filters on is\_decoy. A GetAllEntries overload with includeFragments, or one that yields the index, would let the bridge wrap it directly.
